Name: Golden Scythe recolor (Prismatic)
Author: BluPenDragon
Description:
recolors the Golden Scythe to match "Prismatic tools" [s]i may add the milk pail, shears, and pan later or maybe not... IDK yet[/s]
Milk Pail, Shears & Copper Pan recolor in the optional file

mod install instructions
1) install Smapi,
2) drop Content Patcher, & Prismatic Tools AND this mod into your mods folder

optional file installation
1) locate Prismatic Tools Mod within your mods folder
2) navigate to Prismatic Tools/assets
3) overwrite "tools.png" with the optional file "tools.png"
